dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface exhibit high-contrast, irregular light-colored perimeters. The gradient transition from the dark fur to the light-intensity ring edge is sharp, with the most prominent posterior ring showing a slightly thicker, solid white-intensity edge on its anterior side.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity light pixels are densely packed on the posterior third of the subject, transitioning from distinct circular rings to solid, asymmetrical white-intensity blobs near the hind flipper and tail regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle. A secondary cluster of smaller, solid blobs on the upper-right posterior flank forms a tight-packed hexagonal arrangement of points relative to the larger dorsal structures.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region is markedly darker than the post-cranial region, showing a significant reduction in the frequency and size of macro-annuli, with only faint, low-contrast speckling visible near the neck fold.
